text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Mm... you're here. Alright, let's get 
goin'. Present huntin' time.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Thank you for your help. Let's find 
the absolute best gift for everyone in 
Funabashi...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
So, how 'bout this accessory shop? Pretty 
popular with the older crowd.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
This design is... no, but Ippei-san 
might... What about this one? Yet 
Sayaka-san might...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Then how 'bout this! Dango, youkan, 
manju... With an assorted set, everyone 
can eat what they like, right?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
True... Ah, but there was talk about blood 
sugar levels being a concern lately...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. I just can't seem to make up 
my mind.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Don't sweat it. Pickin' out presents 
is always like that.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I used to struggle a ton with it too. Back 
when I was a squirt—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ! How did you solve it back then?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me, I want to use it as a 
reference. At this rate, I feel like I'll 
never decide...!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh! Alright, alright, fine!! Don't you 
dare tell anyone else, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—...Earmuffs. I made 'em... when I was 
little.

text_block_list.name: Young Espo
text_block_list.text:
Loud noises are scary, right?! Well, now 
you'll be totally fine!

text_block_list.name: Young Espo
text_block_list.text:
I'm... kinda bad at sewing, but... Still, 
um, you know...!

text_block_list.name: Espo's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you so much. Mommy is very, 
very happy.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...! I see... What truly matters in a 
present is—

text_block_list.name: Man from Funabashi
text_block_list.text:
"This'll help you remember, right? 
Remember Funabashi—and that you're never 
alone."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Pouring one's heart into it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yeah, exactly. So—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Yes! In other words, as long as my 
feelings are there, there's no need to 
obsess over material items—!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Like hell there isn't!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
The folks you wanna send it to are 
precious to ya, right?! Just like my mom 
was to me!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Then I'm tellin' ya to aim for the best!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Is just givin' an item the best?! Is just 
givin' feelings the best?! Are you stupid 
or what?!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Don't get it twisted! It wasn't like I 
just wanted to give her somethin' 
handmade!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I poured everything into makin' those 
earmuffs so Mom wouldn't be startled by 
loud noises!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Turn your absolute best feelings into a 
proper physical gift! Give your emotions 
your own unique shape!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
That's what makes it... the best, 
dammit!!!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: !! Espo-san...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Your mother... must be very 
happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while browsing for training gear 
at the shopping mall—

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Your passionate feelings, Espo-san, 
undoubtedly reached her.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
W-We're talkin' about you right now, 
dammit!! Quit changin' the subject!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, hey, Trainer over there! What're 
you starin' at?! Get lost, dammit!
choice_data_list: Shopping together? You two get along well.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Huh? What're you sayin'?! As if!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, it's not that we are close. 
Rather, good collaborators.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
! ...No, it's not my place to say. I owe 
Espo-san a debt of gratitude, after all.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: That's right, that's right! ...Wait—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm not doing this for your sake, got 
it?! I told you I was forced into it! 
Don't get the wrong idea!
